// 定时解锁签到v1.1 <br>
// 将时间判断函数、是否提交成功函数包封<br>
<br>
<br>
var s=1000;<br>
var i=1;<br>
var 时 =8,分=23,秒=0;<br>
console.log("程序启动");<br>
<br>
while(true){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; sleep(10*s);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log("第"+i+"判断屏幕是否亮");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; i++;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var a=device.isScreenOn();&nbsp; &nbsp;//监测屏幕是否亮<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(a){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.log("屏幕亮了");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(500);<br>
<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 时间判断<br>
<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; // var 时 =21,分=50,秒=0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;log("开始判断时间");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var myDate = new Date();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var h=myDate.getHours();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var m=myDate.getMinutes();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//if(workHour==currentHour&amp;&amp;workMinute&lt;currentMinute&amp;&amp;currentMinute&lt;=(workMinute+3)<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if( h== 时 &amp;&amp; m &lt;= 分 &amp;&amp; m&lt;=(分+4)) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;swipe(542,1973,941,1973,1000);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; log("现在是"+myDate+"开始执行定时任务");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; threads.start(解锁);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; sleep(10*1000);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; threads.start(上班签到); <br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; sleep(60*1000);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; log("任务结束");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; device.vibrate(1000);//<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; sleep(5*60*1000);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;} <br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;log("还为到"+分+"分");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;} <br>
<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.log("屏幕没有亮");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
<br>
<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; function 解锁() {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;device.wakeUp();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;log("点亮屏幕成功");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(1000);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; //swipe(542,1973,941,1973,2000);&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; //关闭闹钟<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;swipe(device.width/2,device.height/8*7 , device.width/2, device.height/8, 1000)<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;log("滑动成功");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(1500);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var 密码="555555"<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for (var i=0; i&lt;密码.length; i++) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;click(密码[i])<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;sleep(500)<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;log("解锁成功");<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; <br>
}<br>

function 上班签到() {<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;launchApp("企业微信");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(5000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;click("工作台");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(3000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;click("移动考勤");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(3000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;click("上班签到");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(3000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;click("提交");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(5000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;back();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(1000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;back();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(1000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;back();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(1000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;log("签到成功");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sleep(1000);<br>
}<br>

function 下班签退() {<br>
launchApp("企业微信");<br>
sleep(5000);<br>
click("工作台");<br>
sleep(3000);<br>
click("移动考勤");<br>
sleep(3000);<br>

sleep(3000);<br>
click("提交");<br>
sleep(5000);<br>
back();<br>
sleep(1000);<br>
back();<br>
sleep(1000);<br>
back();<br>
sleep(1000);<br>
launchApp("微信");<br>
log("签到成功");<br>
}<br>

function pd(x) {&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;//判断是否提交成功函数，判断内容是否存在X，存在返回true，不存在返回false<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;var tj = textContains(pdnr).find().empty();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(tj){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;tj = false;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;tj = true;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(tj){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log("成功");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log("失败");<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return tj ;<br>
}</td></tr></tbody></table>
